newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine shares eke out slight gain by close.
newsitem.headline: Philippine shares eke out slight gain by close.

text.p: * Selected blue chips, food issues lifts index
Philippine shares closed slightly higher after investors nibbled on selected blue-chips and food counters, brokers said.
The composite index nudged up 14.78 points, or 0.47 percent, to 3,169.26 points amid a 1.3 billion peso turnover.
"The value turnover is still very light ... A lot of investors and fund managers are still away," said Wilfred Son Keng Po, chief operating officer of Angping Securities.
Leading the gainers were index heavyweights Manila Electric Co B, which gained six pesos to 222 pesos, and San Miguel Corp B, which added four pesos to 118 pesos.
PLDT, which was heavily battered on Thursday, closed only five pesos lower amid heavy turnover.
Aside from select issues, other shares were largely ignored by investors.
Brokers said the absence of foreign players kept the turnover slim,adding that normal trading should resume next week.
